title: Legion of Super-Heroes Annual #4 DC 1993 Bloodlines 1st Jamm Timber Wolf
condition_description: Bright cover, light wear at the spine and corners. See photos.
description:
Legion of Super-Heroes Annual #4 (1993), DC Comics - Bloodlines: Earthplague. First appearance of Jamm; Timber Wolf returns to the 30th century. Stu & Ron cover. $3.50 cover price.

Back cover: Six Flags Theme Parks ad (Looney Tunes).

Condition: bright with light wear at the spine and corners (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
